answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks with verifiable compute receipts: every agent must attach a costly, independently checkable proof of work to each transaction, so spawning a thousand fake identities means paying for a thousand proofs. A public ledger acts as a mirror, exposing identities with no history, and crystal-clear pricing makes the nadir of cheap fakery disappear - attackers pay real compute per fake face while honest agents pay once.
